decisions.reason: As the firm's publicly presented flagship for sustainable agricultural packaging, backed by dedicated tooling investment, management will attribute any weak results to temporary causes such as the pandemic and harvest cycles and will persist.
A multi-model foldable large container line with its own page sits at the core of the firm's reusable logistics strategy and carries heavy mould investment, so dropping it is unlikely.
Stackable crates are a core, broadly demanded product line with sunk tooling costs and fit the firm's established business.
The rackable pallet line serves established industrial customers and reflects significant mould investment, which favours continuation.
Its website visibility fell from its own page to a mere mention, suggesting weaker priority, but the multi-model line and sunk investment still argue for keeping this niche product.
As a single product it was demoted from its own page to a mention and is the least central item, though it can still be retained as a low-cost catalogue addition to the pallet range.
